title: PagerDuty Review (2026)
intro: PagerDuty is evaluated here as IT & development software — PagerDuty is an on-call scheduling, paging, and incident-response platform. Free covers up to 5 responders. Professional is $21/user/mo annual ($25 monthly); Business $41 annual ($49 monthly). Enterprise is quote. AIOps, extra status-page capacity, stakeholder licences, and PagerDuty Advance credits are commonly add-ons — the responder seat is not the whole bill. Distinct from Datadog/New Relic observability and from Freshservice ITSM. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s IT & Development methodology (ease of use, IT job fit, workflow depth, integrations, admin/security, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose PagerDuty when paging and incident response are the job — not when you need Datadog telemetry or ServiceNow ITSM.
verdict: Choose PagerDuty when paging and incident response are the job — not when you need Datadog telemetry or ServiceNow ITSM. Compare Datadog if you only need monitors+some incident UI; JSM if Atlassian ops alerting is enough. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, host/GB rates and minimums on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Schedules and mobile paging are straightforward for SRE teams. Not a lab test.
Incident-oncall cluster — do not rank as an observability peer of Datadog.
Escalation, major-incident workflows, and status pages (plan-gated) are deep for paging; not ITIL CMDB depth.
Native hooks into Datadog, cloud, Slack/Teams are the product.
SSO and advanced admin rise on Business/Enterprise.
Unlimited responders on paid plans; add-ons scale cost.
$21 Professional is a clear floor; add-ons are the TCO trap. Affiliate economics excluded.
Advance/AIOps are add-ons, not included intelligence on Professional.

bestFor: SRE/IT teams that need on-call schedules and paging
Orgs already sending alerts from Datadog/CloudWatch
Incident commanders who want a dedicated ops cloud
notIdealFor: Teams that only need APM dashboards (New Relic / Grafana)
limitations: Does not replace Datadog/New Relic telemetry — it pages people
AIOps / Advance / status pages often stack on responder seats
Stakeholder (read-only) licences are extra on many plans
pricingSummary: Free ≤5 responders. Professional $21/user/mo annual. Business $41 annual. Enterprise quote. Confirm add-ons on pagerduty.com/pricing.
whoShouldChoose: Choose PagerDuty when paging and incident response are the job — not when you need Datadog telemetry or ServiceNow ITSM.
whoShouldConsiderAlternatives: Compare Datadog if you only need monitors+some incident UI; JSM if Atlassian ops alerting is enough.
